maya: Heads-up — CI flakes on the new quantized evals. Upload step reports missing traces for ~30% of samples, but the runner shows them locally. suspect mismatch between provenance header and S3 keys.
jorge: which keys? we have both "artifact_s3_path" and "s3_path" floating around from old uploader variants.
maya: exactly. some jobs write metadata.s3_bucket + metadata.s3_key, others write artifact_s3_path = "s3://bucket/path". uploader/ingest expects the latter.
samir: i can repro locally. the eval-runner emits header: `provenance: { source: "eval-runner", s3_bucket: "redwood-evals", s3_key: "traces/xyz.json" }` while artifact-uploader looks for `artifact_s3_path`.
emily: noticed this in telemetry too — the UI shows missing artifacts for quantized runs but regular runs are fine. likely why quantized bring-up looks degraded.
ci-bot: ci/eval-runner-upload (workflow) — failed after 2m: exit code 1 — "missing artifact_s3_path in provenance header"
jorge: short-term: we can add a compatibility shim in ingest that assembles artifact_s3_path from s3_bucket+s3_key when absent. longer-term: unify schema.
samir: propose small patch in eval-runner to emit canonical provenance header now: 
```json
{"provenance_version":"v2","artifact_s3_path":"s3://redwood-evals/traces/12345.json","uploader":"eval-runner"}
```
will also add "provenance_version" so we can migrate safely.
maya: +1. also retention TTLs differ; artifacts uploaded by old runner had ttl=90d, new ones default to 7d from uploader config. some samples disappeared during our compare runs.
emily: that explains why some older quantized baselines are missing when we diff eval-later metrics.
jorge: ok action items: 1) ingest shim (quick) 2) eval-runner emit v2 header (samir) 3) CI test update to assert canonical path exists (maya) 4) storage team to align default TTLs (i'll ping infra).
samir: dropping a patch snippet for canonicalization in the runner:
```python
def canonical_artifact_path(meta):
    if meta.get('artifact_s3_path'):
        return meta['artifact_s3_path']
    if meta.get('s3_bucket') and meta.get('s3_key'):
        return f"s3://{meta['s3_bucket']}/{meta['s3_key']}"
    # fallback to legacy fields
    return meta.get('s3_path')
```
maya: for CI, add a test in eval-harness: assert_provenance_fields -> ensure artifact_s3_path resolved, provenance_version present. flaky test was timing out at upload step so increase t=30s.
ingest-bot: created issue #4127 in infra-storage: "Default TTL alignment for eval artifacts (7d vs 90d)" assigned to infra-storage.
deploy-bot: infra patch deployed to staging (artifact-compat-shim). sha: a1b2c3.
jorge: once shim is live we should re-run the failing workflow to confirm. maya can you kick it?
maya: kicked the re-run.`
